mechanism: Nalmefene may precipitate acute withdrawal symptoms in opioid-dependent patients and carries theoretical risk of QT prolongation; amiodarone is a potent CYP3A4 inhibitor that may increase nalmefene levels.
action: Use combination cautiously; monitor for withdrawal symptoms, QT interval changes, and arrhythmias; ensure opioid dependence status is clarified before nalmefene initiation.
